description:
Brunów Palace is a small, two-storey Baroque palace on a square plan, dated to around 1740–1750. Sources differ on its builder, with one naming Count Bernhard von Schmettau and another the von Glaubitz family.

The estate was enlarged by later owners in the 19th century, and the palace was remodelled again around 1900. It is a registered monument.

The palace has served various purposes since the 1920s and is today privately owned, housing a four-star spa hotel; the lowest rate on Booking does not include breakfast.

faqs.answer: It is dated to around 1740–1750 as a Baroque palace; sources differ on the builder, naming either Count Bernhard von Schmettau or the von Glaubitz family.
